scientific_integrity: The all-n argument is symbolic and uses the previously proved 3-by-n chessboard connectivity bound. The included finite verifier is corroborative, not a proof of an infinite range. The scientific review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns only full three-axis nonattacking-rook complexes on 3-by-3-by-n boards for integers n>=3; no equivariant splitting, general other side sizes, or priority certainty is claimed.
title: A six-block homotopy decomposition for three-dimensional \(3\times3\times n\) chessboards
